owner_participation.detail: Two labeled turns are evidence of familiarity. This does not establish what the owner remembers now.

source_manifest.transcript:
L0100 Avery: We are testing what happens when a better appointment time opens up.
L0101 Avery: The calendar assistant moves a booking when a better slot appears.
L0102 Noor: Please don't move it for me. Show me the open slot so I can choose.
L0103 Morgan: Does one approval for the whole day solve that?
L0104 Noor: No. My client picked that time for a reason. I want to approve each move.
L0105 Avery: We can prototype suggested moves without changing the calendar.
L0106 Morgan: Let's test that. We haven't decided to remove automatic moves.
L0107 Noor: A suggestion is useful. A changed appointment is a different promise.
L0108 Avery: End of demo. We'll send you a clickable prototype, not enable calendar writes.
